    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T13" sourceRef="Send_Reminders" targetRef="End_BookingConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TravelBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/travel-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Search" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Options" name="Route, date and time options"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RouteSelection" name="Selected route, date and time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BookingDetails" name="Personal and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Reminder" name="Reminder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Instructions" name="Check-in or boarding instructions"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_TravelBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Search" name="Search request" messageRef="Msg_Search" sourceRef="Send_SearchRequest" targetRef="Start_Search"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Options" name="Options" messageRef="Msg_Options" sourceRef="Send_Options" targetRef="Event_OptionsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RouteSelection" name="Route, date and time" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelection" sourceRef="Task_SelectTime" targetRef="Receive_RouteSelection"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BookingDetails" name="Booking details" messageRef="Msg_BookingDetails" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails" targetRef="Receive_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TicketEmail" name="Ticket by email" messageRef="Msg_Ticket" sourceRef="Send_TicketEmail" targetRef="Event_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TicketSMS" name="Ticket by SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket" sourceRef="Send_TicketSMS" targetRef="Event_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reminder" name="Reminder" messageRef="Msg_Reminder" sourceRef="Send_Reminder" targetRef="Event_ReminderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Instructions" name="Check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_Instructions" sourceRef="Send_Instructions" targetRef="Event_InstructionsReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerBooking" name="Customer starts ticket search"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SearchSplit" name="Ticket type to search"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SearchFlight" name="Search for flight ticket"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SearchTrain" name="Search for train ticket"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SearchBus" name="Search for bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SearchJoin" name="Ticket type searched"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_SearchRequest" name="Send ticket search request" messageRef="Msg_Search"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OptionsReceived" name="Receive route, date and time options">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Options" messageRef="Msg_Options"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select preferred route"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectDate" name="Select preferred date"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectTime" name="Select preferred time"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePersonalInfo" name="Provide personal information"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails" name="Provide payment details"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_TicketReceived" name="Receive ticket">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Ticket" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderSplit" name="Reminders sent before travel?" default="Flow_C18"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReminderReceived" name="Receive reminder">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Reminder" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_InstructionsReceived" name="Receive check-in or boarding instructions">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Instructions" messageRef="Msg_Instructions"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderJoin" name="Reminder step finished"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravelSplit" name="Post-travel feedback or service used?" default="Flow_C25"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide post-travel feedback"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UsePostTravelService" name="Use post-travel service"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravelJoin" name="Post-travel step finished"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C01" sourceRef="Start_CustomerBooking" targetRef="Gateway_SearchSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C02" sourceRef="Gateway_SearchSplit" targetRef="Task_SearchFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C03" sourceRef="Gateway_SearchSplit" targetRef="Task_SearchTrain"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C04" sourceRef="Gateway_SearchSplit" targetRef="Task_SearchBus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C05" sourceRef="Task_SearchFlight" targetRef="Gateway_SearchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C06" sourceRef="Task_SearchTrain" targetRef="Gateway_SearchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C07" sourceRef="Task_SearchBus" targetRef="Gateway_SearchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C08" sourceRef="Gateway_SearchJoin" targetRef="Send_SearchRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C09" sourceRef="Send_SearchRequest" targetRef="Event_OptionsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Event_OptionsReceived" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_SelectDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" sourceRef="Task_SelectDate" targetRef="Task_SelectTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" sourceRef="Task_SelectTime" targetRef="Task_ProvidePersonalInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePersonalInfo" targetRef="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentDetails" targetRef="Event_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="Event_TicketReceived" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" name="Reminders sent" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Event_ReminderReceived">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${remindersSent == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C18" name="No reminders" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C19" sourceRef="Event_ReminderReceived" targetRef="Event_InstructionsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C20" sourceRef="Event_InstructionsReceived" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C21" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderJoin" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C22" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C23" name="Feedback provided" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${postTravelFeedbackProvided == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C24" name="Service used" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelSplit" targetRef="Task_UsePostTravelService">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${postTravelServiceUsed == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C25" name="No post-travel step" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C26" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C27" sourceRef="Task_UsePostTravelService" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C28" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravelJoin" targetRef="End_JourneyCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Search" name="Ticket search request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Search" messageRef="Msg_Search"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Options" name="Send route, date and time options" messageRef="Msg_Options"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_RouteSelection" name="Receive selected route, date and time" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelection"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_BookingDetails" name="Receive personal and payment details" messageRef="Msg_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TicketSplit" name="Split ticket and inventory work"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ChannelSplit" name="Ticket delivery channel"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_TicketEmail" name="Send ticket by email" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_TicketSMS" name="Send ticket by SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ChannelJoin" name="Ticket channel used"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TicketJoin" name="Ticket sent and inventory updated"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderSplit" name="Reminders sent before travel?" default="Flow_T18"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Reminder" name="Send reminder" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Instructions" name="Send check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_Instructions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderJoin" name="Reminder step finished"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BookingConcluded" name="Booking concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T1" sourceRef="Start_Search" targetRef="Send_Options"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T2" sourceRef="Send_Options" targetRef="Receive_RouteSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T3" sourceRef="Receive_RouteSelection" targetRef="Receive_BookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T4" sourceRef="Receive_BookingDetails" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T5" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_TicketSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T6" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T7" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketSplit" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T8" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit" targetRef="Send_TicketEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T9" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelSplit" targetRef="Send_TicketSMS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T10" sourceRef="Send_TicketEmail" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T11" sourceRef="Send_TicketSMS" targetRef="Gateway_ChannelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T12" sourceRef="Gateway_ChannelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_TicketJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T13" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_TicketJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T14" sourceRef="Gateway_TicketJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T15" name="Reminders sent" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Send_Reminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${remindersSent == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T18" name="No reminders" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T16" sourceRef="Send_Reminder" targetRef="Send_Instructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T17" sourceRef="Send_Instructions" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T19" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderJoin" targetRef="End_BookingConcluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says the process ends after a participant carries out a stated activity, and it names no message, signal, timer or condition that the process waits for: Model that activity as a task in the participant's pool or lane, placed before the end event and connected by sequence flows. Do not model it as an intermediate catch event. Use an intermediate catch event only where the description states a wait for an external message, signal, time or condition.
rules.situation: the description says the process ends after a participant carries out a stated activity, and it names no message, signal, timer or condition that the process waits for

rules.instruction: When the description offers an either-or choice between two named ways of carrying out one step (for example 'X or Y'), and both ways continue to the same following step: Model each named way as its own task or path. Place an exclusive gateway before the alternatives to split the flow, with one outgoing branch per alternative. Join the alternative branches with an exclusive gateway before the common next step. Do not drop an alternative, and do not collapse the alternatives into one generic activity.
rules.situation: the description states that one delivery or notification step can be carried out through alternative channels joined by 'or' (for example, one channel or another), and the step then continues to the same following step

rules.instruction: When the description states that a step is performed only if a condition holds, introduced by a conditional phrase such as 'If ..., they are ...' or 'If ..., the process ...': Model an exclusive gateway immediately before that conditional step. Give it one outgoing sequence flow to the conditional step and one to the alternative path, which may skip to a later point or end the process. Route both branches back into the main flow with an exclusive join where they reconverge.
rules.situation: the description says that an activity may take place (optional wording such as 'may') before a later step, without a stated condition that decides whether it happens

rules.instruction: When the description applies one action verb to several named objects joined by 'and' or 'or' within one sentence, such as 'X and Y' or 'X or Y' used as the objects of that action, so each named object is a separate thing the action is performed on: Model each named object as its own task, with the action label taken from the description and the object named separately, placed in the order the description gives. Do not merge the named objects into one combined task label, and do not drop any of them. If the sentence makes the whole group optional, place each of these tasks in the branch that the optional-step gateway controls.
rules.situation: the description applies one action verb to several named objects joined by 'and' or 'or' within one sentence, such as 'X and Y' or 'X or Y' used as the objects of that action, so each named object is a separate thing the action is performed on

rules.instruction: When The description states that an activity may happen only in some cases (for example, "may receive" or "may be sent") and the process continues the same way whether or not it happens.: Model the activity as an optional branch: place an exclusive gateway before the activity to decide whether it runs, add a bypass sequence flow around it, and close both paths with an exclusive gateway before the next step. Give the decision a condition that matches the description's wording.
rules.situation: The description states that an activity may happen only in some cases (for example, "may receive" or "may be sent") and the process continues the same way whether or not it happens.
